title: DSPT x INE: AI Innovation Marathon
description:
**Can you find the real data hidden in the fake?**
DSPT turns 10 this year, and we’re closing it with our first-ever AI Innovation Marathon, together with INE (Statistics Portugal). It’s one week working on a real data challenge from official statistics, with prizes for the best teams.

**The challenge**
INE makes synthetic copies of its data on Portuguese companies and workers. They look real enough for researchers to use, but they’re built to protect the people and companies in the original data.
Your mission is to find where the synthetic data still gives the real data away, and to show INE how to fix it 🛠️

**Key details**

* 📅 **When:** 16 to 21 November
* 📍 **Where:** INE, Av. António José de Almeida, Lisbon
* 👥 **Teams:** 1 to 5 people
* 💻 **Tools:** R or Python
* 💶 **Cost:** Free
* 🏆 **Prizes:** €3,000 in total

**Who should join?**
Data scientists, statisticians, ML engineers, privacy researchers and students. If you like data, privacy or breaking things so they can be made safer, this one’s for you.
**How to take part**
Registering on Meetup doesn’t sign you up. You also have to register through the official form: 👉[https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdgSpAU15ZOwoPBpYhK9rL_3qwojKWB4f3lHzI39R6Fz5PANw/viewform](Registration Link)

Join us in celebrating 10 years of Data Science Portugal!

#DSPT10Years #DataSciencePortugal #SyntheticData #Privacy #AI
